subject.title: [Proposal] Simplify Model Configuration: Single-Source Reconcile + Session Override Reset

question: Should OpenClaw add an official operator reconcile/reset workflow for model configuration, and how should it treat explicit session and auth-profile pins?
rationale: Current code intentionally preserves explicit user/legacy session selections, while the proposal would introduce operator actions that can change persisted session/auth state across agents and stores.

options.title: Design explicit reconcile/reset UX
options.body: Add a dry-run-first command or doctor mode that reports model-source conflicts and only clears explicit session/auth pins when the operator opts in with scoped flags.

options.title: Fold into resolver refactor first
options.body: Keep this proposal open behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87957 until the shared session model/auth resolver defines selected, runtime, display, and stale-state semantics.

options.title: Keep current manual recovery
options.body: Document `/model default`, `/reset`, and doctor route cleanup as the supported recovery path and close or narrow the broader reconcile request later.

recommendation.title: Design explicit reconcile/reset UX
recommendation.body: Add a dry-run-first command or doctor mode that reports model-source conflicts and only clears explicit session/auth pins when the operator opts in with scoped flags.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent current-main implementation and blame for the model CLI, status, session patch, and doctor session-state paths points to vincentkoc.
